notas.titulo: Improved mapping reveals location of small molecules in the brain

notas.titulo: Metastatic pancreatic cancer responds well to treatment with combination of daraxonrasib and chemotherapy
notas.resumen: Daraxonrasib combined with chemotherapy caused substantial tumor shrinkage in patients with pancreatic cancer that had spread to other parts of the body, according to new results from a Phase I/II clinical trial.

notas.titulo: People wade through floodwater because they underestimate danger—how to avoid risk
